theme: Kinetic Luxury (Old Money Tech + Gen Z Energy)

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for large headings > 32px. Never use Inter or Roboto for headings.

body.usage: Use geometric sans for data, UI elements, and reading text.

labels.style: Uppercase, tiny text (text-[10px] to text-xs), wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em])
labels.usage: Use for overlines, tier names, and metadata.

rules: No pure black or pure white. Always tint neutrals with brown/gold.
Use Electric Amber strictly for gamified notification dots, urgent CTAs, and confetti/coin bursts.
Use CP Gold as the primary anchor for premium structural elements.

textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) over dark sections to remove digital flatness.
Gold foil reflections using sweeping linear gradients animated on hover.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8. Elements should breathe.

patterns.home_bento: Asymmetric bento grid for home. 1 tall hero banner (col-span-full row-span-2), followed by 2 small square cards (col-span-1) side by side.
patterns.bottom_nav: Floating pill shape instead of full-width docked bar. Use Glassmorphism. Leave mb-6 gap from the bottom of the screen.
patterns.tier_ladder: Vertical masonry or overlapping staggered cards. Next tier should peek out from the top, enticing the user to scroll.

motion.splash_screen: Elements must 'drop from top' with heavy spring physics (type: 'spring', damping: 12, stiffness: 100). Logo draws in or drops with staggered text.
motion.staggered_reveals: Lists (Explore Stores, Wallet Transactions) must stagger in (0.05s delay per item) from bottom-up.
motion.gamification: Number counters ticking up dynamically for points. Coin drop animations on bill scan success using Framer Motion.
motion.micro_interactions: Scale down to 0.95 on tap (whileTap / whilePressed) for all interactive cards and buttons.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='home-banner-card').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure CP Gold text is readable against Cream bg. If not, darken it for text, use it purely as background with white text.

home_banners.description: Two young women happily carrying colorful shopping bags in a bright mall.
home_banners.usage: Hero banner for 'Explore New Spring Collections'

home_banners.description: Stylish young woman window shopping in a modern mall.

textures_and_gamification.usage: Background overlay for the Platinum/Diamond Tier cards to give them a premium physical feel.
Graphic element for 'Points Balance' or 'Rewards Wallet' section to emphasize gamification.

instructions_to_main_agent: Write code using standard .js and .jsx files. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Use framer-motion heavily for all entrance animations, specifically the requested 'dropping from top' effect on the splash screen.
Rewrite the App's structural layout to enforce a strict max-w-[480px] mobile-first container centered on desktop screens, mimicking a physical phone view.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for the bottom navigation or sticky headers. Use the provided glassmorphism rules.
Implement the 7-tier journey (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Titanium, Diamond, Privilege) as a vertical, overlapping 'ladder' using scroll-linked animations in Framer Motion.
Add gamification micro-animations: animated number counters for points, and a confetti/coin burst effect when scanning a bill.

Convert existing styles to Tailwind CSS where possible, gradually replacing the 4300+ line consumer.css. Use Shadcn components for complex logic but strip their default borders/radii to match the 'Kinetic Luxury' bento aesthetic.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Use lucide-react for all icons, keeping a consistent stroke width of 1.5 for elegance.
Toasts must use 'sonner' for modern, stacked notifications.
universal_guidelines: Never center align the entire app container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with layered z-indexes and dramatic scale contrasts in typography.
Do not use generic assistant emojis for icons.
Every interaction needs a micro-animation (hover, tap, press).
